title: The Globglogabgalab
blurb: "I am the Globglogabgalab..." sings a bloated, slug-like creature from Strawinsky and the Mysterious House, a 2012 animated film that essentially nobody watched until the internet found this one scene. The animation is deeply uncanny, the song is annoyingly catchy, and the pairing earned a second life as one of the strangest memes of the late 2010s. It is a museum piece now. Play it and watch a very specific age bracket start swaying in unison, entirely against their own better judgement.
origin: The Globglogabgalab's song from the 2012 film Strawinsky and the Mysterious House.
